study_design: Hospital-based case-control study using newly diagnosed prostate cancer patients and benign prostatic hyperplasia controls
cohort_total_n_excerpt: Study subjects were 40 prostate cancer patients and 64 benign prostatic hyperplasia controls who were newly diagnosed during 1984-1985 at North Carolina Memorial Hospital in Chapel Hill.
reason: The abstract examines prostate cancer risk factors among 40 newly diagnosed prostate cancer patients and 64 benign prostatic hyperplasia controls. No aggressive, advanced, high-grade, metastatic, or lethal endpoint is analyzed.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: The risk factors examined were medical history (including venereal disease), sexual history, smoking, alcohol consumption, and occupational exposures. Study subjects were 40 prostate cancer patients and 64 benign prostatic hyperplasia controls who were newly diagnosed during 1984-1985 at North Carolina Memorial Hospital in Chapel Hill.
estimate_classifications.reason: Alcohol was examined as a risk factor in the comparison of general prostate cancer cases with benign prostatic hyperplasia controls; no aggressive subtype is specified.
